name: TOPY.AI AI COO skills
description: AI COO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI: the operations centre that keeps every AI cofounder's Routines running on time, never lets a failure go unnoticed, keeps approvals from piling up and reports to the Founder and the CEO. Core skills run on the TOPY COO MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp/coo); standalone skills are operations methods that work anywhere.

tiers.core: Runs on the TOPY MCP server; needs a TOPY account.
tiers.connected: Uses TOPY data and actions when the MCP server is connected; works on its own otherwise.
tiers.standalone: An operations method that works with any agent; can use TOPY where it fits.

skills.name: Connect the AI COO
skills.summary: Connects the founder's AI COO — the TOPY COO MCP server on the same TOPY account as the AI CEO and CFO — and checks that OneMan's Routine scheduler, approval links and Founder email are set up.

skills.name: Daily operations check
skills.summary: The founder's morning operations check: is the scheduler alive, what failed overnight (safe ones retried once), what waits on the founder — quiet when all is well.

skills.name: The COO's goals
skills.summary: The AI COO's four standing goals — Routines run on time, no silent failure, approvals flowing, less founder time per outcome — measured from the scheduler's records, with the status the COO reports to the CEO.

skills.name: Run a Routine now
skills.summary: Runs one Routine now through the scheduler (the same policy gate and approvals as a scheduled run) and reads back where it stopped — for a first try, or to catch up after a fix.

skills.name: Schedule check
skills.summary: Checks every cofounder's scheduled Routines against the scheduling rules — runs a day, on-the-hour starts, clashes, the daily cap, missing inputs and Routines that never report — and proposes fixes.

skills.name: Schedule a new Routine
skills.summary: Picks a good schedule for a new Routine — daily or weekly, off the hour, clear of the other Routines, within the daily cap — and checks it before it goes on the scheduler.

skills.name: Failed runs and safe retries
skills.summary: Looks at failed Routine runs, reruns once the ones that are safe (failed on a read, nothing sent or written outside, not a permission or token error) and hands the rest to a person with the reason.

skills.name: Scheduler down
skills.summary: When the Routine scheduler stops ticking (the routine-watchdog email, or the COO's health check says down): confirm it, say what is not running, and walk whoever has server access through the checks — without guessing a fix.

skills.name: Server health
skills.summary: Reads disk (every mount and its inodes), memory, swap and load on the founder's servers and the OneMan host, says what is near its limit and how soon a growing disk fills, and names who should act — without deleting or restarting anything.

skills.name: Approval reminders
skills.summary: Sends the founder a fresh one-click approval email for runs waiting longer than a threshold (default 24 hours) — once a day per run, never more.

skills.name: Approvals waiting
skills.summary: Shows every Routine paused on the founder — what it waits for, what it found so far, since when, when the link expires — so the founder can decide in one sitting.

skills.name: Automation sweep
skills.summary: Finds repeated manual work (done three times or more) worth turning into a Routine or a service, drafts the Routine's steps and schedule, and leaves the go-ahead to the founder.

skills.name: Efficiency review
skills.summary: Measures how well the Routines run — success rate, retries, cost and failures by cofounder and step — and finds the few changes that would raise reliability or cut founder time.

skills.name: Tool and vendor evaluation
skills.summary: Compares tools, vendors or contractors on weighted criteria and value for money, and recommends one with the reasons — a method that works with or without TOPY.

skills.name: Weekly operations report
skills.summary: The week's operations for the founder (branded email) and the CEO: runs by cofounder, success rate, what fails most, schedule problems and what waits on the founder.
